{{ .Chart.Name }} {{ .Chart.AppVersion }} installed as release "{{ .Release.Name }}" in namespace "{{ .Release.Namespace }}".

Check the controller is running:

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} rollout status deployment/{{ include "podpools.resourceName" (dict "suffix" "controller-manager" "context" $) }}

The image is signed and carries a signed SLSA provenance attestation. Verify it:

  gh attestation verify oci://{{ .Values.manager.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.manager.image.tag | default .Chart.AppVersion }} \
    --repo negativecycle/podpool-controller
{{ if .Values.certManager.enabled }}
Requires cert-manager: the webhook's serving certificate is issued by cert-manager,
which must already be installed in the cluster. If the rollout hangs on the webhook
waiting for its cert, that is the likely cause.
{{ end -}}
{{ if .Values.podSecurityStandards.enabled }}
Namespace "{{ .Release.Namespace }}" enforces the {{ .Values.podSecurityStandards.standard }} Pod Security Standard.
{{ end -}}
{{ if .Values.policy.kyverno.enabled }}
Kyverno image verification is ENABLED in {{ .Values.policy.kyverno.validationFailureAction }} mode.
{{- else }}
Enable admission-time image verification with --set policy.kyverno.enabled=true (requires Kyverno).
{{- end }}
